name: Ca suoi
summary: Fish from the national park’s streams, eaten on the forest walk with sim wine and grilled biên mai seed.
origin: Phu Quoc National Park, on the Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam park account.
howToEat: Eat it with the stream walk.
where: The national park streams. The park names Suối Tranh, suối Đá Bàn, and suối Đá Ngọn.
seoTitle: Ca suoi — stream fish in Phu Quoc National Park
seoDescription: Cá suối is stream fish from Phu Quoc National Park, eaten with sim wine and grilled biên mai seed on the forest walk.
